spice_road.configuration.cookingVariance: Upper bound of the per-flavor multipliers applied to inherited flavor when cooking.
Lower bound of the per-flavor multipliers applied to inherited flavor when cooking. The same ingredients always cook into the same flavor.
spice_road.configuration.flavorMinimumAx: Any flavor that isn't zero counts as at least this strong for effects and tooltips.
spice_road.configuration.flavorSoftCap.t: Strength each flavor approaches when stacking many spices, giving diminishing returns. Stored values are never capped.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMapBasePri: Base emerald price of a Spice Map trade, multiplied by the Spice's tier multiplier. The final price is capped at 128; above 64, the compass is replaced by a second stack of emeralds.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMapLootEna: Whether Spice Maps can generate as chest loot.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMapPriceMu: Spice Map price multiplier (1.0-2.0) for common Spices.
Spice Map price multiplier (1.0-2.0) for epic Spices. Cartographers don't sell these by default.

Spice Map price multiplier (1.0-2.0) for uncommon Spices.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMapSearchR: Maximum distance, in Spice Regions, searched for a Spice Region's heart by /locate spice and by Spice Map chest loot.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMapTradesE: Whether cartographers offer Spice Map trades. Only affects newly generated offers.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMapVillage: Maximum distance, in Spice Regions, a cartographer searches for a Spice Region's heart when offering a Spice Map. Lower values keep trading halls from reaching every Spice.
spice_road.configuration.spiceRegionSalt:
Salt mixed into the world seed when resolving Spice Regions. Defaults to a random value.
WARNING: This affects world generation! Changing it reshuffles every Spice Region, including in already generated chunks.
spice_road.configuration.tooltipAlwaysSh: Always show tooltip content that normally requires holding Shift.
spice_road.configuration.tooltipShowAxis: Show each Flavor Axis' value, multiplied by 10, after its label (e.g. [Spicy: 5]).
spice_road.configuration.tooltipShowBoth: Show both labels of each Flavor Axis (e.g. [Spicy / Cooling]), emphasizing the one matching the value.
